description: Probe for #1418 stage A: the face-score gap between in-memory and saved-file forms, split by cause. One clip per run, four analyze_face_drift arms with the same reference face, samples_per_shot 16 and the default threshold. FM/RP: in-memory frames against the png reference - this job's video_frames decode of 'clip' (the pixels the prep job encoded), held as an in-memory clip by trim_video over all 'num_frames' frames, since analyze_face_drift takes a clip an earlier step returned, not a bare frame array. FM/RJ: the same frames against the jpg reference. FF/RP: the saved mp4 of the prep job's decode of the same clip ('saved_video', an output:) against the png. FF/RJ: the saved mp4 against the jpg. 'reference_png', 'reference_jpg' and 'saved_video' are the files bench/workflows/probe-1418-face-encode-floor-prep.json wrote for the same clip and reference; the defaults are the ep63 Priya prep run (job b7b30ea87fd3), and each other clip passes its own prep run's three files as arguments. FM/RP vs FF/RP is the video-encode share, FM/RP vs FM/RJ the reference-encode share, FM/RP vs FF/RJ the two together. Record: bench/records/face-encode-floor.md. CPU only.
summary: #1418 A: four face-drift arms (frames/file x png/jpg) for one clip.
